overview_description.description: Aerogen Systems develops photocatalytic oxidation systems for removing airborne molecular contaminants and volatile organic compounds. Its technology uses baffled-wafer reactor units to break down trace organics, acid gases, and other airborne pollutants into simpler byproducts. The company offers the 1U Reactor as a modular point-of-use component for air treatment and contamination control, with multiple reactors configurable in series or parallel for different applications. Its systems target semiconductor manufacturing and other environments that require molecular-level control of airborne contaminants.
